about.headline:
Hi, I'm Liam —
and every client has a story.
about.p1: From the very first pair of tweezers I picked up, I knew eyebrow design was more than beauty — it's confidence, femininity, and feeling whole. I founded Liam's Beauty out of a genuine love for this craft and for every woman who walks through my door.
about.p2: I specialize in custom eyebrow design for every face shape and professional hair straightening treatments — using Ministry of Health approved materials, advanced technology, and attention to every detail. Every client leaves with results that last — and a smile that stays.

items.text: The highest level of professionalism. Liam listens, explains, and customizes the treatment perfectly. For the first time I felt someone truly saw what I needed.

items.name: Dana Mizrahi
items.text: I visited for the first time and left with dream eyebrows. Already on my third visit. Liam is the best!

items.a: Brazilian straightening typically lasts 3–5 months depending on hair type and maintenance. Japanese straightening lasts 6–12 months. Keratin lasts 2–4 months. I always recommend professional shampoo and conditioner to preserve the results.

It depends on the method. Threading feels like a gentle pinch and passes quickly. Waxing feels similar. Most clients adapt quickly and some even fall asleep during the treatment. Remember — 15 seconds of minor discomfort for perfect eyebrows that last weeks!

items.q: Is straightening suitable for all hair types?
items.a: Yes! There are different types of straightening suited for every hair type — from fine and delicate to thick and curly. At your first appointment, I check your hair condition and recommend the best solution.

items.q: How far in advance should I do eyebrow design before an event?
items.a: I recommend getting eyebrows done 3–5 days before a big event, so the skin can calm down from any minor redness (rare) — and you'll arrive at the event with perfect brows.

items.q: How do I get to the studio?
items.a: The studio is located in Or Akiva — convenient location with parking. The exact address is sent after appointment confirmation. Home visits in the Or Akiva/Caesarea area can also be arranged (by prior arrangement).
We understand things happen — you can cancel or reschedule up to 24 hours in advance at no charge. Later cancellations may incur a partial cancellation fee.

items.q: Are the materials you use safe?
items.a: Absolutely. I use only materials approved by the Israeli Ministry of Health — tested and safe. Clients with sensitivities are welcome to inform me in advance so I can tailor the treatment accordingly.
Of course! The studio is friendly and welcoming. If you have a young child, let me know in advance and we'll arrange the treatment as conveniently as possible for you.
